title: TTZipPackedArenaContract
description: JSON schema for zero-copy contiguous arena memory bridging across Swift-Rust FFI boundaries.

total_bytes_len.description: Total length in bytes of the contiguous UTF-8 path buffer.

count.description: Total number of paths in the arena.

path_offsets.description: Start byte offset for each path inside the contiguous buffer.

path_lens.description: Byte length of each path inside the buffer.
